people.name: Joseph Francis Charles Rock
people.field: botanist, explorer, geographer, linguist, ethnographer and photographer

relations.subject: Joseph Francis Charles Rock
relations.role: teacher of Latin and natural history
relations.evidence: Initially Rock taught Latin and natural history at Mills College (now known as Mid-Pacific Institute).

relations.subject: Joseph Francis Charles Rock
relations.evidence: In 1911, the herbarium was transferred to the College of Hawaii (later the University of Hawaii) with Rock as its first curator and the Territory of Hawaii's first official botanist.

relations.subject: Joseph Francis Charles Rock
relations.evidence: The U.S. Department of Agriculture employed him as an agricultural explorer, sending him to Southeast Asia in search of seeds of the Chaulamoogra tree

relations.subject: Joseph Francis Charles Rock
relations.evidence: In 1944 the U.S. Army Map Service employed him for his geographic expertise on the Yunnan section of the exceptionally hazardous route designated "The Hump"
